sections.heading: Match every payment to a bill
paragraphs: When a retailer pays by UPI, write down the UPI reference and the bill it pays. A payment with no bill is a payment you cannot explain at day-end.

sections.heading: Keep the UPI reference with the bill
paragraphs: The UPI reference is the proof that the money came in. Keep it with the bill, not in a chat message you cannot find later.

sections.heading: Close the day with UPI matched
paragraphs: Before you close the day, check that every UPI payment is matched to a bill. What is left unmatched is what you must chase tomorrow.

summary: Match every UPI payment to the right bill, and close the day with nothing unexplained.
title: How to reconcile UPI payments as a distributor
